cards.title: Some / any
cards.body: Two small words before nouns when you do not say exact number. some and any often mean 'a bit of' or 'one or more'.
cards.body_cz: Dvě malá slova před podstatným jménem, když neříkáš přesný počet.
points: some ≈ + (I have…)
any ≈ − and ? (I don't… · Do you…?)

cards.title: some (+)
points: Use some in normal + sentences
Works with things you cannot easily count (coffee) and plurals (books)

cards.title: any (−)
points: don't / doesn't / isn't / aren't + any
Also OK in life: no coffee ≈ not any coffee (both fine here)

cards.title: any (?)
points: Questions usually take any
Yes answer can use some: Yes, I have some.

cards.title: some in offers
cards.body: When you offer or ask for something politely, English often uses some — even in a question.
cards.body_cz: V nabídce nebo zdvořilé žádosti často some — i v otázce.
points: Offer / request → some is normal
Do you have any…? = real question about existence

cards.title: no = not…any
points: English says the negative ONCE — Czech says it twice (nemám žádný).
no + noun → the verb stays positive.
Never two negatives: ~~I don't have no coffee~~.

cards.title: any in + = it doesn't matter which

table.caption: two different meanings
rows: real bread I actually bought — NOT any

points: any in a positive sentence = jakýkoli / kdykoli / kamkoli.
A real specific thing = some: I bought some food, never ~~I bought any food~~.

cards.title: something · anything · nothing

table.caption: the same rule, one level up

points: I want something · I don't want anything · I want nothing.
Nobody / nothing / nowhere already contain the `no` — the verb stays positive.

cards.title: Common mistakes

table.caption: check
rows: Do you have some milk? (offer = different)
I don't have any coffee. = I have no coffee.
I didn't say anything. = I said nothing.

points: + → some · − / ? → any (basic rule)
Offers: Would you like some…?
cards.body_cz: Klad: some. Zápor a otázka: any. Nabídka: some.

cards.title: Remember
points: some → + statements
any → negatives and most questions
Would you like some…? · Can I have some…? (offers)
Works with there is/are and have
cards.body_cz: + some · −/? any · nabídka some. S there is a have.
